question: What claim is made about the speaker's intention with respect to the arrangement of the yoginī row?
premises: The arrangement of the yoginī row is the object in view.
The speaker intends to tell it.
The telling is directed to the beloved one.
inference: The speaker shall tell the arrangement of the yoginī row to the beloved one.
uncertainties: The details of that arrangement are not given in this verse.
plain_english: I shall tell you, O beloved, the arrangement of the yoginī row.
